job: Make one claim beside one piece of media, with a ruled list of points under it.
purpose: Two columns: the text (a head and fd-site-points) and the media (an fd-doc-frame with a product specimen, a picture in fd-site-media, or a taller list of points). data-side puts the media first, data-ratio="media" widens it, data-sticky keeps the text in view while a taller column scrolls. Below desktop it stacks.
useWhen: A claim that a picture of the product proves.
A long list of points beside a short claim (data-sticky).
A claim a photograph sets the mood for: an fd-site-media in the media column.

avoidWhen.when: A third split in a row.
avoidWhen.instead: Break the run with a full-width section: site-stats or site-quote.

variants.useWhen: The text sticks while a taller column scrolls.
